narrative: 摄影机本身就是那记打击。体育转播包装和音乐录影带中的暴力场面会用它，让接触感被感知为一个有质量的物体正在到来，而不只是画面被裁得更紧。
近处的物体会产生拖影；最后几帧可以锁定在击中的瞬间。不要把它用于表现一个念头。
表现顿悟需要的是推镜头或急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）。一个从未真正命中任何东西的高速机械臂镜头，只是一次没有语法意义的快速推轨。
how: 机身沿撞击轨道、钢索或机械臂抛掷路径运动，瞄准一个软垫、一个身体或一个球。快门速度很高；速度可达每秒数十米，随后是一次硬停止或程序化的收尾。
视差非常剧烈，因为节点确实在移动。提示词：a bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.
when: 当这场戏的重点是撞击时使用它：一拳、一脚、一次碰撞测试、副歌的重音时刻。不要把它当作装饰用在一个从不接触任何表面的远景镜头上。
vs: 急推变焦是光学层面的效果：摄影机保持不动，焦距突然变化。高速机械臂则是真实的空间位移。
穿越机航拍在飞行中可能会失手；而这是装置上一次瞄准好的抛掷动作。机械臂运镜（Robo Arm）可以重复同一路径，但不带有那种撞击式的能量感。
examples_film: 体育转播的撞击画面包装和音乐录影带的撞击特效单元是它的语法来源。这是一种特技摄影机镜头，不是用来拍对话的工具。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是急推变焦。破绽在于：没有视差，背景只是单纯地放大。
修正方法：要求机身在撞击装置上真正移动，近景平面产生拖影，接触时刻再收尾稳定。

faq.q: What is Bolt Cam in film?
faq.a: 高速机械臂是一台超高速摄影机，在撞击装置上被抛掷向一个撞击点，然后停止。镜头是真实地在空间中移动；击中的瞬间就是这次运镜的终点。

faq.q: Bolt Cam vs Crash Zoom In
faq.a: 急推变焦是在机身固定不动的情况下改变焦距。高速机械臂则是让摄影机在空间中高速移动，因此近处的物体在定格之前会产生错动。

faq.q: When should I use Bolt Cam?
faq.a: 当摄影机本身就是那一拳时使用它：接触瞬间、特技动作、副歌的冲击时刻。不要把它用于安静的特写镜头。

faq.q: How do I prompt Bolt Cam for AI image or video?
faq.a: 描述一次撞击装置上的击打动作和最终的定格。示例：Bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.

narrative: The camera itself is the strike. Sports packages and music-video violence use it when contact has to be felt as a mass arriving, not as a tighter crop.
Near objects smear; the last frames can lock on the hit. Do not use it for a thought.
A realization wants a push or a crash zoom. A bolt cam that never hits anything is just a fast dolly with no grammar.
how: The body rides a crash rail, wire, or robotic throw aimed at a pad, a body, or a ball. Shutter is high; speed is tens of meters per second, then a hard stop or a programmed settle.
Parallax is violent because the nodal point really moves. Prompt a bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.
when: Use it when impact is the beat: a punch, a kick, a crash test, a chorus hit. Do not use it as decoration on a wide that never meets a surface.
vs: A Crash Zoom In is optical: the camera stays put and focal length snaps. Bolt cam translates.
An FPV Drone flies and can miss; this is a aimed throw on a rig. A Robo Arm can repeat a path without the crash energy.
examples_film: Sports impact packages and music-video crash units are the grammar. The shot is a stunt camera, not a dialogue tool.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a crash zoom. The tell: no parallax, the background simply enlarges.
The fix: demand body travel on a crash rig, smear in the near plane, then a settle at contact.

faq.q: What is Bolt Cam in film?
faq.a: A bolt cam is an ultra-high-speed camera thrown on a crash rig toward an impact, then stopped. The lens physically travels; the hit is the end of the move.

faq.q: Bolt Cam vs Crash Zoom In
faq.a: A crash zoom changes focal length on a locked body. A bolt cam moves the camera through space at high speed, so near objects shear before the freeze.

faq.q: When should I use Bolt Cam?
faq.a: Use it when the camera is the punch: contact, a stunt, a chorus impact. Do not use it for a quiet close-up.

faq.q: How do I prompt Bolt Cam for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a crash-rig strike and a freeze. Example: Bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.
